labels.notes: ETT.tex:1358-1362 checked against Causal.SFALocal.btz_pas_tarentin, which is (forall p, p in C.Zplus) and (forall p, p in C.Zminus <-> p notin sing M 0). It assembles mem_Zplus and mem_Zminus_iff. Z+/Z- are def:strongly_tarentin_point verbatim (Causal/Properties.lean:137-140). Hypotheses: [SingularGXStructure (Flat.isom 2) (Minkowski 2) M], C.AbsolutelyMinimal, IsoChartsCoverDEC25 (Flat.isom 2) C (minkowski 2) massAModelCausality. These are at least as weak as the paper's under the disclosed readings. (a) The cover implies MassACovered M (massACovered_of_isoChartsCover: an aeAtlas source is in Reg, so a singular point gets an X_A-chart), so the statement is about E>=0-manifolds in DEC-25's sense and nothing wider, mixed ones included. (b) Conversely, MassACovered M plus IsAtlasCausalityDEC25 (OQ-18's 'natural') gives both hypotheses (of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25 = <hC.2.2, hC.isoChartsCover hcov>). (c) Any such C is the natural one when that exists (massA_causalite_unique_dec25, MassADEC25.lean:241). 'BTZ points' = sing M 0 = the points some IsAEChart into E0 sends to the axis (sing_zero_eq); it is chart-independent by eq_of_mem_singAt. Nothing in the statement involves sing_alpha for alpha > 0, so the sing_{2pi} reading does not bear on this row. The other lemmas check out. sing_pos_eq is for kappa > 0, kappa != 2pi, through E_kappa's line. sing_two_pi = empty; eq_of_mem_singAt covers E0/E_kappa through source_subset_reg_of_isAEChart_e0_massive and _massive_e0, and kappa/kappa' through BPrimeEAlpha.eq_of_isAEChart. disjoint_sing, mem_sing_iff (under MassACovered) and eq_none_of_mem_sing_zero are stated as claimed. E0 special case: sing_eq_of_e0Covered (SFALocal.sing = SFALocalE0.sing) and isoChartsCoverDEC25_of_e0 (IsE0Natural -> the family cover), so the T-ett-sfa-local-e0 row content is subsumed. singularFlatAxioms_iff: the forward direction is the bare projection <h.singularPastAt, h.Iplus_of_lt, h.line, h.massive_line>, so the four right-hand conjuncts are definitionally those fields of Causal.Causality.SingularFlatAxioms (Causal/SingularFlat.lean:150-206). The backward direction builds the other 15 fields: Iminus_eq_empty, past_local, pushUp, absolutelyMinimal, causallyArcConnected, tarentin, mem_Zplus, mem_Zminus_iff, t2, secondCountable, metrizable, locallyCompact, noIsolated, isClosed_sing, interior_sing. Readings OQ-18, OQ-34/35 and OQ-82 are disclosed; partial and unmarked is correct. Non-vacuous at E0 (sing0 = axis nonempty) and at E_pi (sing_pi = line, sing0 = empty); no witness has points of both kinds (disclosed).

That is weaker than the paper's (the natural causality satisfies it, of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25), so OQ-18 does not bear on this row. 'Topological spacetime' (ETT.tex:254: second countable Hausdorff) is carried as [T2Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M] where used, as part of 'manifold'. DEC-25 adopts gx's def:singular_manifold_locally_connected, RamcovGX.tex:474, which is settled by T-ett-sfa-local-e0 AUDIT-1. E_kappa's local model facts: massive_locZplus, massive_locZminus (off empty) and massive_locTarentin, from massive_causallyArcConnected, massive_stronglyCausal and massive_Zplus/Zminus/tarentin through E0LM.locZplus_of/locZminus_of/locTarentin_of. massAModel_* cases on o. Topological fields: metrizableSpace, locallyCompactSpace, nhdsNE_neBot, isClosed_sing (through the type invariance), exists_isOpen_sing_eq_inter, interior_sing (Sing skeletal). They are true as stated and are evidence for prop:GX_sing_dec rather than for this row; listing them follows the T-ett-sfa-local-e0 precedent. Readings OQ-34/35 and OQ-82; partial and unmarked is correct.

findings.what: Finding 1 (cross-type invariance) is true of the Lean proof and its hypothesis, but overstated as a finding about the paper. The line numbers are right (BTZ_1.tex:388-389, Cor. 1.5), and ETT never cites that corollary. Under one isomorphic chart at each point (IsoChartsCoverDEC25), with sing M 0 read through every IsAEChart, the exclusion 'no X_A-chart into an E_kappa reaches a BTZ point' is needed, and it is a model fact (eq_none_of_mem_sing_zero, from notMem_axis_of_isAEChart). The remark's own hypothesis is stronger: 'the unique causal structure inducing that of E_alpha in every chart' (l.1339-1340), with every chart an isomorphism. Under it the exclusion is itself 'read in a chart', in two charts. An E0-chart sending p to the axis and an E_kappa-chart through p, both isomorphisms, would give no chronological past at p (defi:causal_E0) and one (defi:causal_Ealpha) in their common domain. That is auditor probe (i)/(ii), using only E0LM.e0_locNoPast and massive_locZminus. So the sentences 'the BTZ half uses a second fact the remark does not mention', 'Without it a BTZ point could lie in the source of an isomorphic chart into an E_kappa' and 'The remark is correct once it is cited' are false in the paper's every-chart reading. Cor. 1.5 is what makes that causality exist ((b′) between E0 and E_kappa, MassAModelsInstance.chartIso_models_none_some) and what makes the notation sing_alpha(M) well defined. Both belong to defi:causal_Ealpha and to the first uses of sing_alpha(M) (l.899, l.1437), not to this remark. Relation to T-ett-sfa-local-e0's finding (OQ-18, absolute minimality): the content is distinct, a model fact rather than the gluing. It is a refinement, though, not an independent gap. Both appear only once 'every chart an isomorphism' is weakened to 'one isomorphic chart at each point', and under the every-chart reading the minimality gap stays (OQ-18) while this one disappears.
findings.fix: Do not forward the finding as worded. Either drop it as a paper finding and keep it as a note on the Lean proof, or forward it in this corrected form as a citation remark. 'ETT.tex:899, 1339-1340, 1437 (citation only): sing_alpha(M), hence « BTZ point », presupposes that a singular point is locally modelled on exactly one E_alpha, brunswic2021cauchy Cor. 1.5 (BTZ_1.tex:388-389). ETT cites Cor. 1.7, Lem. 1.9 and Prop. 1.10 of that paper but not Cor. 1.5, and the existence of the causality of defi:causal_Ealpha rests on it between E0 and the E_kappa (Causal.MassAModelsInstance.source_subset_reg_of_isAEChart_e0_massive). Given that causality, rem:btz_pas_tarentin needs nothing more: two isomorphic charts through a BTZ point, one into E0 and one into an E_kappa, would disagree on I⁻(p) in their common domain. Suggested: cite [brunswic2021cauchy, Cor. 1.5] at defi:causal_Ealpha or at the first use of sing_alpha(M).' In SFALocal.lean SCOPE l.78-80, add: 'Under the every-chart reading (IsAtlasCausalityDEC25) the exclusion follows from the local model facts in two charts; eq_none_of_mem_sing_zero is needed because the hypothesis here is one isomorphic chart at each point.' Use 'Cor. 1.5' in the docstring (l.26-28, l.40, l.81).

findings.what: The sing_{2pi}(M) question is not genuinely open, and it bears on neither row. Settled part: DEC-25 computes Sing as the complement of the maximal a.e. atlas's support, and EAlphaGX.sing_eq_empty_two_pi (Causal/Model/EAlphaGX.lean:379) gives Sing(E_{2pi}) = empty, which agrees with DEC-74 ('E_{2pi} is regular'). brunswic2021cauchy Cor. 1.5 defines 'locally modeled on E_alpha' for x in sing(M), so sing_alpha(M) ⊆ Sing(M) and sing_{2pi}(M) = empty is forced. The only residue is the l.2185 convention 'alpha = 2pi if p is regular', which is exactly OQ-25's open question (DECISIONS.md:182: 'sing_α is read for α ≥ 0 via the geometry's singular locus, without the convention'). The closer's justification is half right. The convention puts Reg(M) in sing_{2pi}(M), against interior_sing. For the literal reading, the identity chart of E_{2pi} gives only the line {r = 0}, whose interior is empty, so 'in either alternative interior_sing fails' does not follow from the argument given. It does hold, because X_A-charts composed with translations send every regular point to the line, giving Reg(M). Both alternatives also contradict prop:GX_sing_dec's 'closed 1-submanifold' (l.1437) outright. Neither row's statement involves sing_alpha for alpha != 0: rem:btz_pas_tarentin uses sing_0 only, and rem:sing_tarentin no sing at all.
findings.fix: Open no OQ-87. Do not add 'the sing_{2pi} reading' to either row's blocked_on. Optionally record under OQ-25 that Causal.SFALocal.sing_two_pi takes the same reading at every E>=0-manifold, and that the l.2185 convention would break prop:GX_sing_dec at alpha = 2pi, so it must stay local to that proof. Reword SFALocal.lean l.83-86: 'Read with the line {r = 0} of E_{2pi}, or with the convention of l.2185, sing_{2pi}(M) would contain every regular point (through X_A-charts composed with translations), against prop:GX_sing_dec and interior_sing; the reading empty is forced by DEC-25's computed Sing (EAlphaGX.sing_eq_empty_two_pi, DEC-74) and Cor. 1.5's x ∈ sing(M); the convention is OQ-25's.' Add 'OQ-25 for the l.2185 convention' to the checklist row at l.69.

rem:btz_pas_tarentin.notes: For α > 0 every point is strongly tarentin both ways (Z⁺ = Z⁻ = E_α); the BTZ half is a field of SingularFlatAxioms. (WP-10, audited) T-ett-sfa-local-e0 (atlas-team, 2026-11-21, AUDIT-1 minor): the E₀-manifold case and the model-free transfer (Causal/SFATransfer.lean, Causal/Port/SFALocalE0.lean). T-ett-sfa-local (atlas-team, 2026-11-21), audit AUDIT-1 minor (cross-type finding re-scoped to the Lean hypothesis; sing_{2π} settled by DEC-74 and OQ-25; wording), Causal/Port/SFALocal.lean: both halves at every E≥0-manifold, mixed ones included. The causality is any absolutely minimal one with an isomorphic chart at each point over the family E₀, E_κ (κ > 0) (IsoChartsCoverDEC25 … massAModelCausality); the natural one is such (of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25), and when it exists it is the only one (massA_causalite_unique_dec25). Every point is in Z⁺ (mem_Zplus), and p ∈ Z⁻ ↔ p ∉ sing₀(M) (mem_Zminus_iff); assembled in btz_pas_tarentin. Z⁺ = M and M ∖ sing₀(M) ⊆ Z⁻ are chart facts. past_local (pastLocal) and I⁻(p) = ∅ at a BTZ point (Iminus_eq_empty) also use, under this hypothesis, the cross-type invariance: no X_A-chart into an E_κ reaches a BTZ point (eq_none_of_mem_sing_zero, from MassAModelsInstance.source_subset_reg_of_isAEChart_e0_massive). I⁻(p) = ∅ also uses absolute minimality (kb/0135). sing₀(M) is the set of points an X_A-chart into E₀ sends to the axis (sing_zero_eq), the same in every chart by the type invariance (eq_of_mem_singAt; brunswic2021cauchy Cor. 1.5, BTZ_1.tex:388–389). The E₀ case is a special case (sing_eq_of_e0Covered, isoChartsCoverDEC25_of_e0). singularFlatAxioms_iff: for T2, second countable M, SingularFlatAxioms (sing M) holds iff the four line fields singularPastAt, Iplus_of_lt, line, massive_line do (T-ett-singular-sfa). Not vacuous at M = E₀ (sing₀ = axis ≠ ∅; nonvacuous_e0, e0_singularFlatAxioms) or at M = E_π (sing_π = line ≠ ∅, sing₀ = ∅; nonvacuous_epi); no witness has points of both kinds. Hypotheses: E≥0-manifold → read (DEC-25: SingularGXStructure (Flat.isom 2) (Minkowski 2) M with its singular points in X_A-charts into MassAModel, MassACovered M, which the cover implies: massACovered_of_isoChartsCover); its causality → read (OQ-18: absolutely minimal, with an isomorphic chart at each point; minimality is used by I⁻(p) = ∅ only); BTZ points = sing₀(M) → read (through the X_A-charts); E₀ and Isom(E^{1,2}) → read (OQ-34, OQ-35; OQ-82); Hausdorff and second countable → not used by the statement (carried by singularFlatAxioms_iff only, as part of « manifold »: RamcovGX.tex:474, DEC-25).

rem:sing_tarentin.notes: E_α (α > 0) is tarentin. (WP-10, audited) T-ett-sfa-local-e0 (atlas-team, 2026-11-21, AUDIT-1 minor): the E₀-manifold case (Causal/Port/SFALocalE0.lean). T-ett-sfa-local (atlas-team, 2026-11-21), audit AUDIT-1 minor, Causal/Port/SFALocal.lean: every E≥0-manifold, mixed ones included, is tarentin, with small open diamonds in every open set (tarentin, locTarentin; E_κ in local form: massive_locTarentin, massAModel_locTarentin). This holds for every causality with an isomorphic chart at each point (IsoChartsCoverDEC25 over MassAModel), by charts alone: neither absolute minimality nor separation nor countability is used. With Hausdorff and second countability, part of « manifold » (RamcovGX.tex:474, the definition DEC-25 adopts), M is a tarentin topological spacetime as printed. The charts also give: metrizable, locally compact, no isolated point (metrizableSpace, locallyCompactSpace, nhdsNE_neBot); each sing_α(M) closed, open in Sing(M), with empty interior (isClosed_sing, exists_isOpen_sing_eq_inter, interior_sing; closedness through the type invariance eq_of_mem_singAt); sing_{2π}(M) = ∅ (DEC-74; the l.2185 convention is OQ-25's). Beyond the row: every such causality that is absolutely minimal is causally plain (causallyPlain; evidence for OQ-16 at every E≥0-manifold, not an answer). Not vacuous at M = E₀ or M = E_π (nonvacuous_e0, nonvacuous_epi). Hypotheses: E≥0-manifold → read (DEC-25: SingularGXStructure (Flat.isom 2) (Minkowski 2) M with its singular points in X_A-charts into MassAModel, which the cover implies); its causality → weakened (an isomorphic chart at each point, which the natural one satisfies, of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25; OQ-18 does not bear); E₀ and Isom(E^{1,2}) → read (OQ-34, OQ-35; OQ-82); Hausdorff and second countable → carried (metrizableSpace, singularFlatAxioms_iff), read as part of « manifold » (RamcovGX.tex:474, DEC-25; prop:GX_sing_dec, ETT.tex:1435, and DEC-90 agree).
